notes.title: On the 7th of autumn, log in to benefit delivery & daily recharge gift bag
notes.notes:
Dear superpower:

From September 13 to September 19, the golden autumn welfare was released! Every day you log in to the game, you will receive mysterious and surprising welfare letters! Don't miss it! Thank you for your support to the game! At the same time, we have also prepared a daily 6 yuan recharge gift bag and a daily 30 yuan recharge gift bag for you. After recharging, enter the player exchange group and contact the administrator to get the corresponding activation code! The specific contents of the gift package are as follows:

Day 1: bind diamond * 100 mirror Arsenal secret key * 1 level 1 gem Gift Bag * 1 Physical potion * 2

Day 2: bind diamond * 50 intermediate light wing upgrades * 5 primary light wing upgrades * 61 million gold coins

Day 3: Level 1 gem Gift Bag * 3 intermediate mecha upgrades * 5 primary mecha upgrades * 10 bound diamonds * 38

Day 4: bind diamond * 66 treasure hunt secret key * 2 upgrader Gift Box * 101 million gold coins

Day 5: bind diamond * 88 treasure hunt secret key * 3 level 3 gem Gift Bag * 1 sweep voucher * 10

Day 6: bind diamond * 100 treasure search secret key * 3 level 2 Gem Gift Bag * 12 million gold coins

Day 7: Treasure Hunt secret key * 3 primary super medal * 8 88 binding diamond 1 million gold coins * 1

6 yuan recharge gift bag: physical potion * 4 level 1 gem Gift Bag * 3.5 million gold coins

30 yuan recharge gift bag: Qiling breakthrough device * 10 Qiling upgrade device * 20 physical potion X8 100 bound diamonds

notes.title: Game login exception compensation
notes.notes:
Dear superpower:

I'm sorry that some players were unable to log in between 15:00 and 16:00 on August 27 due to the abnormality of the game server. At present, the siege lion has been repaired urgently and can log in normally. We will pay compensation for you. Thank you for your continued support and encouragement. I wish you a happy game.

The compensation contents are as follows:

100 bound diamonds * 2

Rose * 20

Physical potion * 5
